justification: Nodemailer is used strictly for outbound mail dispatch and does not parse untrusted inbound email headers (CVE-2026-90776 / ReDoS in addressparser). Upgrading to nodemailer >=10.0.5 is currently blocked by the 7-day quarantine policy in .npmrc (min-release-age=7) as v10.0.5+ was released fewer than 7 days ago.
